name: External or unapproved MCP server is reachable from an agent that can access sensitive data
description: Detects when external or unapproved MCP server is reachable from an agent that can access sensitive data using only declared evidence.
securityIntent: Prevent the risk condition described by AGCF-XSP-004.
remediationIntent: Correct the provider configuration or relationship and reassess with complete, fresh evidence.
